name: Atrium building / 01
description: Three furnished office floors with a central glazed atrium, private stone façades, solid wing roofs, CEO and boardroom balconies, and a landscaped entrance. Includes 57 scheduled exit signs, 27 portable extinguisher stations with paired signs, and nine refitted washrooms. HVAC, plumbing and rooftop equipment are conceptual; planned BMS points are unavailable until connected. P01 adds proposed pumps/controllers, domestic booster, electrical boards, racks/UPS, upper-floor AHUs and a rear condenser yard with separate tank reservations. R01 adds separate fire-water, floor ventilation, VRF/condensate, wet-service, power and data route studies with independent inspection layers. D02 adds room-relative sensor, terminal, light and switch candidates plus equipment instrumentation, with separate design status and unconnected data.
